alerts.title: Encoded PowerShell launched by Microsoft Word

alerts.description: WINWORD.EXE opened 'Q3_Payroll_Adjustments.docm' from the Outlook cache and spawned powershell.exe with -EncodedCommand and a hidden window. The decoded command downloads and executes a script from 203.0.113.50.

alerts.title: LSASS memory read by rundll32 via comsvcs.dll MiniDump
alerts.description: rundll32.exe loaded comsvcs.dll and called MiniDump on the lsass.exe process (PID 704), writing C:\Users\Public\lsass.dmp. Parent process is the PowerShell session started from Word eleven minutes earlier.

alerts.title: Periodic HTTPS beacon to a newly registered domain
alerts.description: WS-FIN-0142 contacted cdn-sync.updates-cloud.test (198.51.100.23) 118 times in two hours at a 60 s interval with 4% jitter, 412-byte requests and near-constant response sizes. The domain was first seen 3 days ago; the pattern matches a C2 beacon.

alerts.title: PsExec service installed on a file server from a workstation

alerts.title: Impossible travel: sign-ins from Lisbon and Singapore 18 minutes apart
alerts.description: mgarcia@example.com signed in to the SSO portal from 203.0.113.10 (Lisbon, PT) and 18 minutes later from 198.51.100.77 (Singapore, SG), 11,400 km apart. The second sign-in used a new browser and passed MFA with a push approval.

alerts.title: MFA fatigue: 23 push requests denied, then one approved
alerts.description: akumar@example.com received 23 MFA push requests in 9 minutes from sign-in attempts at 198.51.100.61. The first 22 were denied; the 23rd was approved at 02:14 local time and a session was created for Microsoft 365.

alerts.title: Brute force against the VPN followed by a successful login
alerts.description: 147 failed VPN logins for svc-backup from 203.0.113.99 within 12 minutes, followed by a successful login from the same address. svc-backup is a service account that normally never uses the VPN.

alerts.title: EC2 instance credentials used from outside AWS
alerts.description: Temporary credentials of the instance role app-prod-ec2-role (instance i-0a1b2c3d4e5f60718) were used from 198.51.100.14, which is not an AWS address, to call ListBuckets and GetObject on s3://acme-finance-exports.

alerts.title: S3 bucket made public: acme-finance-exports
